title: SM94 solder resist dent
text: SM94 is a visual solder resist surface dent or depression. Reject when a single solder resist dent is larger than 40 mils in any direction and visible at the required inspection magnification. The defect can be related to foreign material on tooling, carrier tape, or lamination surfaces.

title: CU64 copper adhesion
text: CU64 describes bad copper adhesion. CU64 M1 is a fixed unit and fixed location crush, often caused by foreign material on the LXP work stage that crushes or scratches dry film. Recommended actions include checking dry film surfaces at LXP outgoing inspection and cleaning the LXP work stage regularly.
